head.title: Private Chef Date Night Dubai | myCHEF
head.meta_description: Plan a private chef date night in Dubai with a three-course dinner for two, menu preferences, kitchen checks and clear package inclusions.

opening_paragraph: A private chef date night in Dubai creates time for the two of you at your own table. myCHEF’s Date Night package starts at AED 1,200 for a three-course dinner for two, with the menu, service and kitchen clear-down agreed before the evening.

new_paragraphs: Share favourite dishes, ingredients to avoid and anything that makes the occasion meaningful. A familiar dish prepared with care can be as memorable as an adventurous menu. The chef will discuss what works within the package and kitchen facilities.

Choose the dining space, music and lighting, then confirm access and the equipment available in the kitchen. Ask what table setup is included and whether flowers, candles or other details are part of the quote or arranged separately.

The AED 1,200 Date Night price applies to the defined two-person package. Extra courses, drinks and upgrades are quoted separately, with 5% VAT confirmed in the proposal. Bespoke plated menus at AED 700–950 per person have a different scope.

replace_in_block.block_on_your_page: Give the evening room to breathe
replace_in_block.new_heading: Give the evening room to breathe
new_paragraphs: Agree the chef’s arrival time and when you would like to sit down. Tell the team about any surprise or particular timing requirement, and let them know who can answer practical questions on arrival.

Compare the complete service, including the menu, guest count, preparation, staffing, equipment, delivery and clear-down. A per-person price is useful only when the inclusions are clear. Ask which elements are fixed and which can change if your plans change.

Share allergies and other dietary requirements before confirming. The culinary partner should explain the preparation arrangements and any remaining cross-contact risk. Review the payment schedule, cancellation terms and change deadlines in your written booking.

Send the date, Dubai address, expected guest count and preferred service time, together with your menu ideas and venue details. Photos of the kitchen or service area can help the team assess what is practical.

myCHEF typically replies within 15 minutes between 9am and 11pm Dubai time. The tailored proposal follows once the requirements and availability have been reviewed. A first reply is an acknowledgement, rather than confirmation that a chef or date has been secured.
